sup:70110.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. For many years, our family foundry has taken great pride in supplying your respected company with high-quality castings from our region, and we value our long standing relationship very much.

Our team has prepared our offer carefully. We can offer you a price of €138.55 per unit, valid from 1 November 2026. This Angebot remains valid for 30 days.

To remain transparent about our situation, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost. We trust that you understand the necessity of these figures for our ongoing operation and quality standards.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

move.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for explaining your position.

Our data shows a different picture on some points:
Your letter gives 51 days' notice (doc:20260911-70110-P01), while our framework agreement requires 90 days (ctr:4600070110#3.1).
Our last 3 orders for this part were at EUR 126.53 per unit (po:4500014428-10, po:4500014358-10, po:4500014313-10).
Producer prices DE: electric power generation, transmission and distribution changed -6.1% from 2025-11 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-D351@2025-11, idx:PPI-D351@2026-08).

Please find our proposal below.
If faster payment helps you, we are open to it, as shown in the packages.

We look forward to your reply.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. As to the index change and price history and notice period data you cited, we did not know that - a fair point. 

LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost. That remains. We have carefully reviewed your data regarding the contractual notice period and the energy index, and as a reliable partner, we respect these verified facts. 

We gladly accept your proposal of 14-day payment terms and agree to shift the effective date to 1 January 2027. With these terms in place, we can offer a revised price of €134.40 per unit, which represents a significant step toward your position. 

Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. Our standard terms apply to everything the quote does not state; see attached. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. This proposal is valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We did not know that - a fair point. 

While your proposed price remains out of reach, we are prepared to make a further concession to a price of €132.50 per unit. This offer maintains the 14-day payment terms and the 1  January 2027 effective date we previously agreed upon. 

For our family foundry, our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. However, a binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to? 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We deeply value our long relationship and look forward to hearing your thoughts.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

decisions.tactician: o2 has the lowest C of the options (tied with E0 and o3) and fixes E0's flaw: it moves the date to the first valid one, so our notice argument is consistent with the sheet. Short payment meets its strongest need, cash. o3's April date would read as overreach, given the renewal window. This is a firm opening that stays well below its ask. Later moves can rise toward o2's health price of about €132, which avoids a margin penalty, so I am not conceding toward it now.

decisions.tactician: Its standing sheet already shows C 1,119,719, but it is moving fast and is not final, so a counter should gain more. E0 keeps the date and payment it already agreed. The 2027-01-01 date is the only valid one: November is contractually invalid, and April costs us slightly more. The other options do not fit: o1/o4 rely on an invalid date, and the longer-payment options raise our C and hurt its cash need. The volume-growth argument (a3) speaks to its volume need without attacking it. I left out the should-cost argument (a1) because its estimate (€132.64) sits near its own ask and helps its case more than ours.

why.tactician: Every counter option, E0 included, gives our C around €1,120k–€1,130k. That is higher than accepting offer:70110-2 at €1,116,696, because lower prices push the supplier below full cost and trigger the relationship charge. The pay-14 d, January terms already match its cash need and the contract constraint. Pushing further only adds cost for us and risks the relationship.
